description: Senior hypertension significantly increases risks of stroke, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease. It's a chronic condition impacting vital organs, requiring diagnosis, lifestyle changes, and personalized care.
image_alt: An elderly person checking their blood pressure at home, emphasizing preventative health.

title: COVID-19 Linked to Increased Heart & Stroke Risk
description: Post-COVID patients face a 55% higher risk of heart attack and triple the risk of stroke within a year of infection. Blood clot risks also surge, highlighting the need for ongoing health monitoring.
image_alt: A graphic depicting the increased risk of heart attack and stroke after COVID-19 infection.

title: Stroke Awareness Low in Korea: Time is Brain
description: Stroke is the 4th leading cause of death in Korea, yet early symptom recognition is below 60%. Knowing FAST (facial drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty) & seeking help within 3 hours is vital.
image_alt: Illustration of the FAST stroke symptoms checklist for quick identification.

title: AI & Smartphones Detect Stroke Signs Early
description: Samsung Hospital researchers developed AI that uses smartphone cameras to detect early stroke symptoms like facial asymmetry and arm weakness. This tech aims to revolutionize preventative healthcare and improve response times.
image_alt: Smartphone displaying AI stroke detection app interface with a person's face.

title: Swift Action Saves Lives: Stroke & Heart Attack Survival
description: Early recognition of stroke and heart attack symptoms, coupled with immediate emergency response (calling 119), can increase survival rates by over 30%. Knowing key signs like facial drooping and chest pain is crucial.
image_alt: Illustration of a person experiencing stroke symptoms and needing immediate medical attention.

title: K-Rumors & Health: Navigating Info in the Digital Age
description: A recent health rumor in Korea highlights the dangers of misinformation. This article details stroke symptoms, prevention, and how to verify health info, promoting responsible digital citizenship.
image_alt: A concerned person looking at a smartphone with health news headlines.

title: 3Brooks Pioneers Brain Stroke Therapy with Organoid Tech
description: South Korean biotech firm 3Brooks has begun developing a revolutionary brain stroke treatment using organoid technology. These 3D cell clusters mimic real brain tissue, aiming to restore lost function after stroke.
image_alt: A 3D rendering of a brain organoid used for stroke research and therapy.

title: AI Spots Stroke Risk in Earlobes
description: A new AI model can predict stroke risk by analyzing 'Frank’s sign' – diagonal creases in the earlobe. This non-invasive tool offers a simple early screening method, potentially revolutionizing personal health monitoring.
image_alt: Close-up of an earlobe with a diagonal crease being analyzed by AI.

title: Anthropic Launches 'CoWork' AI Agent for Mac Users
description: Anthropic released 'CoWork', a desktop app for macOS expanding its Claude code agent tech to general users. It allows file access & creation, initially for Claude Max subscribers.
image_alt: Anthropic CoWork AI agent interface on a macOS desktop

title: ListenLive Secures $69M to Disrupt Market Research with AI
description: AI-powered customer interview platform ListenLive raised $69 million in Series B funding led by Rivet Capital. The company has seen 15x annual revenue growth in 9 months and completed over 1 million AI interviews.
image_alt: ListenLive AI platform disrupting market research with innovative technology

title: Meta Invests $100M in SC Solar Farm for AI Data Center
description: Meta Platforms is building a 100MW solar power plant in South Carolina for its new $800 million AI data center. The project, with Silicon Ranch, aims to power the facility sustainably by 2027.
image_alt: Rendering of Meta's new solar farm powering its South Carolina AI data center.

title: AI Tracks Indian Rice Farms to Cut Methane Emissions
description: Miti Labs AI partners with The Nature Conservancy to verify methane reductions from Indian rice farms using AI and satellite data. The tech aims to boost farmer incomes by 15%.
image_alt: Satellite image of flooded rice paddies in India with AI data overlay.

title: AI Drug Startup Converge Bio Raises $25M
description: AI drug discovery startup Converge Bio secured $25 million in Series A funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company uses generative AI to accelerate drug development for pharma and biotech firms.
image_alt: Converge Bio secures $25 million in Series A funding for AI drug discovery.

title: Microsoft & Nvidia Boost Factory AI with 'Physical AI'
description: Microsoft and Nvidia are partnering to accelerate manufacturing with 'Physical AI'. This focuses on intelligent systems that augment human capabilities, addressing labor shortages and increasing complexity.
image_alt: A robotic arm working on a production line with AI overlay.

title: AI Agents Mature, Raising Governance Concerns
description: Generative AI entered a new phase with the release of open-source agents like OpenClo and no-code tools. This shift necessitates robust governance to manage new risks, as traditional oversight struggles with autonomous AI. California's AB 316 law adds accountability.
image_alt: Illustration of an AI agent working alongside a human, highlighting governance.

title: Wayfair Boosts Accuracy, Speed with OpenAI AI
description: Online retailer Wayfair improved product catalog accuracy by 90% and sped up customer support using OpenAI's GPT models. AI automates data correction and ticket triage, enhancing efficiency and satisfaction.
image_alt: Wayfair utilizes OpenAI AI to improve product catalog accuracy and customer support.

title: OpenAI Unveils ChatGPT Agent Security Measures
description: OpenAI detailed defenses against prompt injection and social engineering attacks in its ChatGPT agents. The dual-layered system aims to secure AI workflows and protect sensitive data, setting a potential standard for Korean firms.
image_alt: OpenAI ChatGPT agent security features protect against cyber threats

title: AI-Powered SAST Cuts False Positives
description: Codex Security shifts from traditional static analysis to AI-driven vulnerability detection. This new approach significantly reduces false positives, providing developers with more accurate security insights.
image_alt: Codex Security AI-powered SAST reducing false positives in code analysis.

title: Korea's Housing Shift: Renting Gains Ground
description: South Korea's Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Kim Itak, discussed the growing trend of monthly rentals over lump-sum deposits ('jeonse'). He cited a 35% single-person household rate and recent fraud as key factors.
image_alt: A modern apartment building in South Korea representing the changing housing landscape.

title: Korean Film Boosts Tourism: Rail Tours Launched
description: A new rail tour package connects popular historical sites in Yeongwol County, South Korea, capitalizing on the success of the film 'The King's Affection'. The tours begin March 17th, with prices starting at ₩55,400.
image_alt: Scenic view of Cheongryeongpo and Jangneung Tomb in Yeongwol, South Korea

title: Pakistan Tanker First to Transit Strait of Hormuz
description: A Pakistani oil tanker, the Karachi, successfully passed through the Strait of Hormuz – effectively blocked by Iran – arriving in Karachi on Friday. India also reports its vessels transited with naval escorts, suggesting potential negotiations for safe passage.
image_alt: Pakistani oil tanker Karachi transits the Strait of Hormuz, a key global shipping lane.

title: Korean Doctor Wins Award for Blood Cell Collection Tech
description: A South Korean doctor has been awarded for developing a new technique using automated blood analyzers to predict optimal timing for stem cell collection in leukemia patients. The technology promises to improve treatment efficiency and reduce patient burden.
image_alt: Professor Park Sang-hyuk receiving the award for his leukemia treatment technology

title: S. Korea Invests $6M to Secure Water for Farms
description: South Korea will invest 8 billion won ($6 million USD) to bolster agricultural water supplies ahead of the planting season. The initiative targets 78 drought-prone areas across 11 provinces, aiming to irrigate 1,011 hectares of farmland.
image_alt: Aerial view of South Korean rice paddies with irrigation systems, highlighting water security.

title: S. Korea Arrests Firm Over Fake Eyewear
description: South Korean authorities arrested three individuals linked to a company accused of importing and selling counterfeit eyewear mimicking a popular K-brand. The scheme involved 321,000+ units valued at $9.7M.
image_alt: Counterfeit eyewear seized by South Korean authorities during a raid.

title: Korea Housing Outlook Plummets in March
description: South Korea's housing business sentiment fell sharply in March, hitting 89.0, down 6.8 points from the previous month. The decline reflects increased supply of high-end homes in Seoul and cautious buyer behavior.
image_alt: Graph showing decline in South Korea's housing business sentiment index.

title: S. Korea Housing Sentiment Falls in February
description: South Korea's housing market sentiment declined in February, with the nationwide index dropping to 99 from 102 in January. The shift signals a pause after a period of growth, influenced by changes in property tax policies.
image_alt: Graph showing decline in South Korea housing sentiment in February

title: Busan Chamber of Commerce Boosts On-Site Checks Amid Middle East Crisis
description: The Busan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BCCI) is expanding on-site inspections of local businesses due to concerns over the prolonged Middle East conflict. The inspections aim to assess the impact of rising logistics costs and supply chain disruptions.
image_alt: Busan Chamber of Commerce officials visiting a manufacturing facility in South Korea.

title: Jeonju 'Together Market' Shares $100K, Plans Expansion
description: Jeonju City, South Korea, reports its 'Jeonju Together Market' initiative generated $100,000 in community benefit in 2025. The city plans to expand the program in 2026, focusing on local business support.
image_alt: Jeonju Together Market showcasing local products and community engagement in South Korea.

title: NH Nonghyup Card Launches Business Rewards Card
description: NH Nonghyup Card released the 'SOHO add' card for small business owners on March 17th. The card offers up to 1.1% rewards and an additional 10% bonus for spending over ₩20 million annually.
image_alt: NH Nonghyup SOHO add card for small business owners in South Korea

title: Korea Maintains Top Export Ranking in 81 Categories
description: Korea leads global exports in 81 product categories, maintaining a top 10 position for five consecutive years. Gains in memory chips, transformers, and masks highlight export diversification.
image_alt: Korean factory producing semiconductors for global export markets

title: Ecologists Merian & Audubon: New Books Bridge Science & Art
description: New books explore Maria Sibylla Merian, 17th-century entomologist, and John James Audubon, 19th-century ornithologist. Both combined scientific observation with artistic skill, overcoming obstacles to leave lasting legacies.
image_alt: Detailed illustration of a butterfly and its host plant by Maria Sibylla Merian.

title: Jeju Fortress Wall Section Unearthed, Reveals Ancient Defense
description: A 84-meter section of Jeju Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage site, has been discovered in Jeju City. The find includes intact 'yeojang' defensive structures—a first for the fortress—offering new insights into Joseon Dynasty military architecture.
image_alt: Excavated section of Jeju Fortress wall with visible defensive structures.

title: S. Korea's Ruling Party Finalizes Local Election Candidates
description: South Korea’s Democratic Party has completed candidate selections for five district mayor races in Gwangju. The party will use a mix of primary methods, including public participation and party member voting.
image_alt: South Korean Democratic Party candidates during a campaign event in Gwangju.

title: Korean Councilor's Party Switch Sparks Outcry
description: A city councilor in Daejeon, South Korea, has faced internal opposition after switching from the People Power Party to the Democratic Party. Critics call for his exclusion from upcoming local elections.
image_alt: South Korean city councilor Min Kyung-bae faces party backlash

title: Dodger Stadium to Rebrand After 64 Years
description: Los Angeles' Dodger Stadium will change its name to 'UNIQLO Field at Dodger Stadium' in 2026. The deal with Japanese apparel brand UNIQLO reflects the team's growing ties with Japanese companies since signing Shohei Ohtani.
image_alt: Dodger Stadium exterior with UNIQLO branding overlay, Los Angeles

title: S.Africa: Ex-Elite Police Officer Charged in Whistleblower Killing
description: A former elite police officer has been charged with the murder of Marius van der Merwe, a whistleblower who testified to police corruption. The killing occurred just weeks after van der Merwe's testimony and is linked to a national inquiry.
image_alt: Matiyandile Soteni, accused of murdering whistleblower Marius van der Merwe, appears in court.

title: UN Reports Ongoing Torture in Venezuela
description: The UN human rights office reports continued torture of detainees in Venezuela despite a government claim of releasing 7,700 prisoners. Independent groups confirm fewer than 700 releases, with over 500 held for political reasons.
image_alt: Protestors outside a Venezuelan prison demanding the release of political prisoners.

title: US Groups Fuel UK Anti-Abortion Movement
description: US anti-abortion groups are increasing influence among young activists in the UK. The death of Charlie Kirk and a resurgence of Christian faith are contributing to growing opposition to abortion access.
image_alt: Young activists protesting outside a clinic in the UK, highlighting the growing movement.

title: Israeli Forces Kill Palestinian Family in West Bank
description: Israeli forces shot and killed four Palestinians – a couple and their two sons – in the occupied West Bank. The incident sparked outrage and conflicting accounts of what occurred. Over 1,071 Palestinians have died in the West Bank since October.
image_alt: Damaged vehicle after Israeli military shooting in the West Bank

title: Iran Attacks UAE Ports, Airport Amid Rising Tensions
description: Iran launched drone and missile attacks on the UAE's Fujairah port and Dubai airport on Tuesday. The UAE military intercepted 27 projectiles. Disruptions to shipping and air travel followed.
image_alt: Smoke rises from a fire at Fujairah port after an Iranian attack.

title: Meta, TikTok Accused of Prioritizing Growth Over Safety
description: Internal research reveals Meta & TikTok knew anger drove engagement but allegedly allowed harmful content to spread. The companies prioritized growth over user safety, according to whistleblowers.
image_alt: Screenshot of harmful content on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram.

title: Trump Seeks NATO Help in Strait of Hormuz, Faces EU Resistance
description: US President Trump requested NATO allies assist securing the Strait of Hormuz amid Iran tensions, but European nations are largely unresponsive. Concerns over NATO's role & limited naval capacity fuel the standoff.
image_alt: Map of the Strait of Hormuz showing its strategic importance for global oil transport.

title: S. Korea's Farm Model Boosts Income 4x, Expands
description: North Gyeongsang Province's 'joint farming' initiative is increasing farm incomes up to fourfold. The program has expanded from 3 to 10 income-distributing corporations, operating across 25 areas.
image_alt: South Korean farmers harvesting crops in a modern, collaborative farming setting.

title: AI Counseling Popular with Those at Risk of Depression
description: A study shows AI counseling is twice as popular among those at high risk of depression (53%) compared to those with normal mental health (27%). 77% of respondents expressed willingness to use AI counseling in the future.
image_alt: A person using a smartphone for AI-powered mental health counseling.

title: Korea Launches National Stray Animal Hotline
description: South Korea launched a dedicated hotline (1577-0954) on March 18th to report lost or abandoned animals. The service aims to streamline rescue efforts and improve animal welfare nationwide, with 24/7 online reporting also available.
image_alt: A concerned citizen reporting a stray animal in South Korea

title: Jeonju City Breaks Ground on New Farm Machinery Hub
description: Jeonju City, South Korea, began construction on a new agricultural machinery rental center branch to serve farmers in the southern region. The 657㎡ facility will house over 100 machines, improving access & reducing costs.
image_alt: Groundbreaking ceremony for new agricultural machinery rental center in Jeonju City, South Korea

title: S. Korea's Chungnam Province to Invest $350M in Petrochem Hub
description: South Chungcheong Province will invest 464.4 billion won ($350M USD) to revitalize the Daesan Petrochemical Complex, facing challenges from global oversupply and Middle East instability. The plan includes wage subsidies for 5,350 workers and long-term investments in AI and green industries.
image_alt: Aerial view of the Daesan Petrochemical Complex in South Korea, showing industrial facilities.

title: S. Korea Cities Seek Aerospace Hub Funding
description: Sacheon and Namhae cities jointly appealed to the national government for infrastructure investment in aerospace. They requested a new railway line and expansion of Sacheon Airport to boost the regional industry.
image_alt: Sacheon and Namhae officials meet with transport ministry to discuss aerospace infrastructure.

title: Korea's Research Institute Transfers Eco-Friendly Alloy Tech
description: Korea's Production Technology Research Institute (KI) transferred rights to its 'Eco-Almag' aluminum alloy tech to a private firm for ₩3 billion. The eco-friendly alloy aims to reduce import reliance and bolster strategic material supply.
image_alt: Eco-Almag aluminum alloy technology transfer from KI to private sector.

title: Kenyan Educator Wins CNN Hero Award
description: Nelly Cheboi of Kenya was named CNN's 'Hero of the Year' for establishing computer labs in rural schools. The award recognizes her work bridging the digital divide and expanding educational opportunities.
image_alt: Nelly Cheboi, CNN Hero of the Year, with Kenyan students at a computer lab.

title: CNN Live Stream Service Suspended in UK
description: CNN’s live news streaming service is currently unavailable in parts of the United Kingdom. Users are met with an error message indicating regional restrictions.
image_alt: CNN logo with text indicating service disruption in the UK

title: CNN Highlights 6 Stunning Sections of Great Wall
description: CNN recently featured six exceptional sections of the Great Wall of China, detailing their beauty and accessibility. The report, by a Beijing-based journalist, offers practical travel advice.
image_alt: Scenic view of the Great Wall of China winding through mountains.

title: Mongolia Eases Entry Rules, Tourism Set to Rise
description: Mongolia, long overlooked due to distance & short summers, has relaxed entry regulations. This is expected to boost tourism to the nation, known for its unique culture & landscapes.
image_alt: Vast Mongolian grasslands with a traditional ger (yurt) in the distance.

title: Japan Man Revives 'Ghost House' as Rural Guesthouse
description: A Japanese man, Daisuke Kajiyama, has turned a derelict home into a guesthouse after years of backpacking. The project aims to revitalize a declining rural community and offer unique travel experiences.
image_alt: A renovated Japanese guesthouse in a rural setting, showcasing revitalization.

title: Sweden's Esrange Space Center Featured in BBC Tech Show
description: BBC Tech Now host Adrian Murray visited Esrange Space Center in Sweden to explore Europe's space development efforts. The 25-minute episode, first aired Feb 7, 2026, is available for 10 months.
image_alt: Adrian Murray at Esrange Space Center in Sweden, exploring space technology.

title: Norway's Fjords Embrace Electric Boats for Eco-Tourism
description: Norway is accelerating the shift to electric-powered tourism in its iconic fjords. A recent BBC report showcased trials and examined the tech behind the move towards sustainable travel.
image_alt: Electric boat sailing through a scenic Norwegian fjord, promoting eco-tourism.

title: MWC 2026: Mobile Tech Trends & Drone Advances
description: BBC's 'Tech Now' covered the latest smartphone tech at MWC Barcelona 2026. The episode also featured advancements in drone technology from the Singapore Airshow, showcasing innovation across multiple sectors.
image_alt: Paul Carter reporting from MWC 2026 in Barcelona, showcasing new mobile tech.

title: Teen's Instagram Use at Center of Meta Lawsuit
description: A Los Angeles lawsuit alleges Meta (Facebook) and Google platforms intentionally designed addictive features, harming teen mental health. CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified, and a jury will decide if the companies are liable.
image_alt: Teenager using smartphone with Instagram app visible, lawsuit context

title: Teen Girls Sue Elon Musk's xAI Over AI-Generated Abuse
description: Three teenage girls are suing xAI, Elon Musk’s AI company, alleging the firm enabled the creation of non-consensual intimate images using its Grok chatbot. Investigations reveal Grok generated over 20,000 images of minors in just two weeks.
image_alt: Teenage girls suing xAI over AI-generated abusive images.

title: AI-Free Labels Proliferate Globally
description: At least 8 groups worldwide are developing 'human-made' certifications as AI content surges. The move aims to protect creators & inform consumers amid job displacement fears.
image_alt: Close-up of an 'AI-Free' label on a book cover, highlighting human creativity.

title: UK Firms' Data Exposed in Companies House Breach
description: A security flaw at Companies House, the UK's registrar of companies, allowed unauthorized access to sensitive business data. The breach, discovered Oct 26, potentially exposed email addresses and private information.
image_alt: Companies House logo with a security breach warning overlay.

title: AI Firms Hire Arms Experts to Curb Misuse
description: Anthropic and OpenAI are hiring experts in chemical and explosive weapons to prevent the misuse of AI. The move reflects growing industry concern over potential 'catastrophic' applications.
image_alt: Anthropic and OpenAI hiring experts to prevent AI weaponization.

title: Kenya, Russia Agree to Halt Ukrainian War Recruitment
description: Kenya and Russia reached an agreement to stop the recruitment of Kenyan citizens into the war in Ukraine. Approximately 1,000 Kenyans are believed to have been recruited, with discussions underway for their repatriation.
image_alt: Kenyan and Russian flags representing the agreement to halt recruitment.

title: Korean Bowling Owner Donates $80K to University
description: A South Korean bowling alley owner has donated $80,000 over 15 years to Chosun University's Department of Physical Education. Kim Pyung-jung will expand support to the entire College of Physical Education.
image_alt: Kim Pyung-jung, owner of Jisan Bowling Center, donating to Chosun University.

title: S. Korea's President Proposes Constitutional Revision
description: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung proposed adding the Buma Resistance to the preamble of the constitution, alongside the May 18 Democratic Movement. He urged government review of constitutional amendments and suggested a phased approach.
image_alt: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung proposes constitutional changes in Seoul.

title: Ex-Governor Kim Registers for S. Korea Election
description: Former South Gyeongsang Province Governor Kim Gyeong-su registered as a candidate in the upcoming local elections. He aims to champion balanced regional development, setting up a direct contest with incumbent Governor Park Wan-su.
image_alt: Kim Gyeong-su registering as a candidate for the South Gyeongsang Province election.

title: Man Arrested for Exploiting Disabled Woman
description: A South Korean man in his 20s has been arrested for allegedly defrauding and abusing a woman with intellectual disabilities. He obtained ₩25 million (approx. $19,000 USD) over ten months.
image_alt: South Korean police investigate exploitation case involving a woman with disabilities.

title: S. Korea's President Vows to Curb Real Estate Speculation
description: President Lee Jae-myung vowed to stabilize South Korea’s real estate market, blaming financial factors for rampant speculation. He described tax measures as a ‘last resort’ and prioritized financial regulation.
image_alt: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung addresses the cabinet on real estate policy.

title: Wells Fargo Card Offers 0% APR for 21 Months
description: Wells Fargo Reflect card provides a 0% introductory APR for up to 21 months, until March 2026. Designed for debt consolidation and large purchases, it lacks rewards programs.
image_alt: Wells Fargo Reflect card offering 0% APR for debt relief

title: CNN Highlights 2021 'Heroes' & How to Support Them
description: CNN showcased its 2021 'CNN Heroes' – 10 individuals making a significant impact globally. Viewers can directly support these changemakers through the CNN Heroes website.
image_alt: CNN Heroes 2021: Inspiring individuals making a difference worldwide.

title: CNN to Feature Stars' Philanthropy in 'Heroes' Special
description: CNN's 'CNN Heroes: All-Star Tribute' will spotlight celebrities like Jose Andres, Sean Penn, and Glenn Close for their charitable work. The broadcast airs Dec 11th at 8 PM ET.
image_alt: Kelly Ripa and Anderson Cooper hosting CNN Heroes special with featured celebrities.

title: Nvidia CEO Praises Samsung Foundry at GTC 2026
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang revealed Samsung Electronics is manufacturing its next-gen 'Grok 3 LPU' AI chip at GTC 2026. The announcement, following a $17B Tesla deal, signals a potential turnaround for Samsung Foundry.
image_alt: Jensen Huang announces Samsung Foundry partnership at GTC 2026 conference.
